name: Johnny Joestar Twisted Fate
creator: zezo
description:
The skin includes multiple voicelines when walking, dying, doing any of the Ctrl's, Q, W and R.
Any questions/whatever, just message me on discord: Manito.0

The voicelines are from the game JJBA Eyes of Heaven. Voice acted by Yūki Kaji.
Music from Ctrl + 3 created by **Friedrich Habetler Music** on youtube. Link for the music:
[JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run OST: Main Theme ~ Johnny's Theme | Fan Made](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1McPiczNkGg)

The skin changes voicelines for all skins except for Crime City Nightmare (for now).
Might update the skin with other voicelines once the anime comes out.
